about_the_game:
Welcome to the demo!
You can jump in alone to explore the map and test around 40 available cards, or try out all skins for free.

Note about the demo:
Matchmaking is not available yet. To play with others, invite your friends directly. If you’re looking for more players, join our Discord server and share your game code there!

A social deduction game where crafted cards become spells. Protect allies, sabotage rivals, or prank everyone in a magical fight for survival. 

Play with 6 to 16 players in chaotic multiplayer matches. At the start of each game, you receive spell cards that you can cast as you roam on the map. Some protect, some sabotage, and some just cause trouble for everyone.

Who Do Voodoo features a unique card crafting and action system. As players move freely around the map, they gather magical materials to craft three types of cards: Good Cards to protect and investigate, Bad Cards to sabotage and attack, Fun Cards to prank and confuse.

Cards are played directly on other players in real time, making every round dynamic and unpredictable. Social interaction isn’t just for deception—it’s a strategic tool. Players must read behavior, form alliances, and act with perfect timing.

You play as animated voodoo dolls trapped in a cursed medieval castle, secretly divided into two hidden teams: Good Voodoos and Bad Voodoos. Bluff, deceive, craft magical cards, and outwit your opponents in a high-stakes battle of trust and betrayal.

You can also customize your voodoo doll characters with a variety of skins and cosmetics to express your style and stand out during the chaos.

Will you protect the innocent, spread chaos from the shadows, or simply mess with everyone for fun? In Who Do Voodoo, trust no one and play your cards right.

Key Features:

  • Team-Based Hidden Roles: Players are secretly divided into two opposing teams: Good Voodoos and Bad Voodoos.

  • Card-Based Gameplay: Play three types of cards—Good, Bad, and Fun—to protect teammates, sabotage enemies, or prank everyone. Every action counts.

  • Card-Crafting System: Collect items around the map and combine them to craft powerful or unpredictable cards mid-match.

  • Real-Time Player Interaction: Use cards on other players in real time. Direct, reactive gameplay shaped by timing and intuition. Communicate with others through in-game voice chat system, including proximity chat.

  • Free-Roam Map: Move freely around the map with no fixed paths or movement restrictions.

  • WASD Movement & Mouse Controls: Navigate the map using WASD and interact with players, cards, and voting systems with intuitive mouse controls.

  • Character Customization: Unlock and equip unique skins and cosmetics to personalize your voodoo doll and express your style.

  • One Map Available (More to Come): The game currently features a single detailed map. More themed maps are planned for future updates.

  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
